name: Elmsford Extravaganza I 2026
information: Please note that this competition takes place on a **Tuesday evening**. Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest in order to maintain safety and manage the pace of the competition. We strongly encourage competitors to avoid bringing a guest if possible. All competitors **MUST** arrive by 6:30pm regardless of which group they are assigned to compete in. Any competitor who does not arrive at this time will be subject to disqualification.
